verdict.rationale: Kick's Bill Pay tab shows a live, synced view of outstanding bills, AP aging, and vendor balances from Ramp or BILL, and the docs say you can 'view and manage' bills there. However, Kick does not execute vendor payments itself, and bill capture, approval routing, and payment scheduling all depend on external AP tools rather than happening in one Kick workflow. Missing for 10: native bill capture/OCR, approval routing, native payment scheduling and execution, a single end-to-end AP workflow without Ramp/BILL, and independent corroboration.
